{{Otheruses|Fever}}
'''Seumadic fever''' was a disease that caused an afflicted's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] to deteriorate.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once lied to a gunman about [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] having Seumadic fever as a child. Chewbacca played along and pretended he was about to collapse, which gave Solo the opportunity to wrest the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] out of the gunman's hands.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
